result.topic_en: Derivation of a reciprocity relation for Legendre/Jacobi-type symbols, first for real primes q ≡ 3 (mod 4), then two lemmas and a computation applying the symbol to two-term complex (Gaussian) integers a+bi and A+Bi.
result.transcription:
In diesem Fall wird obige Gleichung
$\left(\frac{m}{q}\right)\cdot p^{\frac{1}{2}(q-1)} \equiv \left(\frac{-q}{m}\right)^3 \pmod q$
Zugleich aber ist allgemein (für $q\equiv 3 \pmod 4$)
$\left(\frac{m}{q}\right)^2 \equiv p^{\frac{1}{2}(q-1)} \mod q$
woraus
$\left(\frac{m}{q}\right)^3 = \left(\frac{-q}{m}\right)^3$
also
$\left(\frac{m}{q}\right) = \left(\frac{-q}{m}\right)$
(Man wird $-q = k$ setzen
also $\left(\frac{m}{k}\right) = \left(\frac{k}{m}\right)$ allgemein wenn $k$ Primzahl $\equiv 1 \pmod 4$
positiv oder negativ
Zur Anwendung auf zweigliedrige complexe Zahlen sind zuvörderst zwei Sätze zu bemerken
1) $\left(\frac{k}{l}\right) = 1$, wenn $k, l$ zwei reelle [-Zahlen ungerade[?]-] Zahlen ohne gem. Div.
und $l$ ungerade
2) $\left(\frac{i}{l}\right) = i^{\frac{1}{2}(l-1)}$ wenn $l \equiv 1 \mod 4$ also
$= (-1)^{\frac{1}{4}(l-1)}$
es sei $a+bi = m$ $A+Bi = M$ ohne gem. Theiler; $a, A$ beide $\equiv 1$
$\left(\frac{a+bi}{A+Bi}\right)\left(\frac{A}{A+Bi}\right) = \frac{Aa + Abi [-+ aBi[?]-] - bAi}{A+Bi} = \frac{aA+bAi + (A+Bi)(a-bi)}{A+Bi}$
$= \frac{aA+bB}{A+Bi} = \frac{A+Bi}{aA+bB}$
oder da
$\left(\frac{A}{A+Bi}\right) = \left(\frac{Bi}{A}\right) = \left(\frac{i}{A}\right) = i^{\frac{1}{2}(A-1)}$ so wird
$\left(\frac{m}{M}\right) i^{\frac{1}{2}(A-1)} = \left(\frac{M}{aA+bB}\right)$ u. eben so
$\left(\frac{M_1}{m_1}\right) i^{\frac{1}{2}(a-1)} = \left(\frac{m_1}{aA+bB}\right)$ also multiplicirend
$\left(\frac{m}{M}\right)\left(\frac{M_1}{m_1}\right) i^{\frac{1}{2}(a+A-2)} = \frac{Mm_1}{aA+Bi} = \frac{aA+bB+(aB-bA)i}{aA+bB} = \left(\frac{i}{aA+bB}\right) = i^{\frac{1}{2}(aA+bB-1)}$

methods.what: Euler-type criterion: square of the symbol equals p^{(q-1)/2} mod q for q ≡ 3 mod 4
Deduction of reciprocity (m/q) = (-q/m) by comparing cubes
Reciprocity law for primes k ≡ 1 mod 4, positive or negative
Symbol of coprime real integers (l odd) in the Gaussian setting is 1

methods.what: Reduction of symbol (a+bi / A+Bi) to a real modulus aA+bB
Product of complementary symbols expressed as a power of i (reciprocity for two-term complex numbers)
